case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to rising alloy and material costs, and we take that seriously. Our options answer it with a longer contract for Blankstahl Werdenfels, so you can plan your capacity with a partner you already know.

On the cost side:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

Option A is the package we can approve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you do not decide pricing alone, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who does, so we can reach a fair solution for both family companies.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our offer provides a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While company policy prevents us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown, we have significantly adjusted our price to €5.40 to reflect the verified data.

We acknowledge the recent index movements and are pleased to support your request for a 24-month contract with 45-day payment terms. For a contract of this duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to responsibly manage material price volatility. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for an index clause on the alloy surcharge, and we have looked at that seriously. None of our options contains one.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.86; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.91; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your team the longest contract with a price that is settled from the start, and it is simple to run. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since price changes at your company may need sign-off beyond your desk, could you take Option A to the person who decides?

We appreciate your openness on the index movements and would like to find a fair solution for both companies.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. I have discussed your request with our management, which allows us to offer a further reduced price of €5.30 for your preferred 45-day payment term. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

To confirm an agreement based on your Option A, we require the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause. Please understand that we cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month contract duration due to material price volatility. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
